name: the spine restarted on another canvas
what_it_changes: Within F11, the room carries its work to a successor canvas, and there the spine runs again: recruiting, choosing a site, building, defending and losing work.
why: Cut rule R3: a level-3 child of F11's key, held by 5 or more of its members, whose lines (read in _analysis/d4a02_keys/add-step_P13_T4-028.txt) state a narrower change than F11's. 'Continuation on another canvas restarts recruitment, representation and defense' (bindingofisaac); 'Successor-canvas continuation renews building and vulnerability to loss instead of merely preserving an image' (gamindustri). These are the labelers' how sentences.
